selection_protocol.method: rank every UTC Monday from 2020-01-06 through 2026-06-22 by SHA-256(seed:date); reject exact previously used weeks and candidates whose five-day clock/context source overlaps a prior seven-day evaluation; then retain the first three non-overlapping dates
selection_protocol.opening_rule: week 2 opens only after week 1 full_pass or promising_but_not_complete; week 3 opens only after week 2 also advances
selection_protocol.ablation_rule: if week 1 primary stops, run mss-close-only-control on the identical week and official union-plan TradeTick stream; change only MSS aggressive-flow agreement
selection_protocol.long_evaluation_rule: no long evaluation until all three frozen primary weeks advance without logic or parameter changes

frozen_market_logic.representation: daily causal cost-resolved equal-notional event bars calibrated only from the immediately preceding completed UTC day
frozen_market_logic.initiative: three-event coherent aggressive-flow shock, at least 40bp move, efficient path and close beyond completed 20-event external structure
frozen_market_logic.accepted_pullback: first later completed event with opposite aggressive flow and adverse close change while its close still preserves outside value
frozen_market_logic.mss: later completed equal-notional event closes through both the accepted external boundary and the frozen pullback internal swing
frozen_market_logic.primary_confirmation: MSS event aggressive-flow sign agrees with the reversal direction
frozen_market_logic.single_ablation: MSS close-only control removes only aggressive-flow agreement; all structure, timing, stop, target, risk, cost and hold rules remain unchanged
frozen_market_logic.entry: NautilusTrader market bracket on the first official venue TradeTick strictly after the completed MSS signal
frozen_market_logic.invalidation: frozen completed-pullback outside extreme plus one 7bp side-cost buffer
frozen_market_logic.target: nearest active unconsumed completed UTC-day or completed Monday-Sunday week high/low strictly beyond the opposite pre-initiative 20-event structure edge
frozen_market_logic.calendar_causality: day/week levels activate only after the source period completes and are removed on the first later completed equal-notional event whose range trades the level
frozen_market_logic.execution_data: official Binance Vision USD-M BTCUSDT aggregate trades converted one-for-one to NautilusTrader TradeTick
